name: Unleash
description: Protects against destructive Unleash CLI and API operations.

destructive_patterns.name: unleash-features-delete
destructive_patterns.description: unleash features delete permanently removes a feature toggle. This cannot be undone.
destructive_patterns.explanation:
Deleting an Unleash feature toggle permanently removes it and all its \ strategies. SDKs will return the default value (typically false). Event \ history is preserved but the toggle cannot be recovered.

\ Safer alternatives: \ - unleash features archive: Soft-delete with recovery \ - Disable the toggle in all environments first \ - Export toggle configuration before deletion

destructive_patterns.name: unleash-features-archive
destructive_patterns.description: unleash features archive soft-deletes a feature toggle.
destructive_patterns.explanation:
Archiving a toggle removes it from evaluation but allows recovery. SDKs \ will stop receiving the toggle and return default values. Archived toggles \ can be restored from the Unleash UI.

\ Safer alternatives: \ - Disable the toggle before archiving \ - Verify no code paths depend on the toggle \ - Document the toggle's purpose before archiving

destructive_patterns.name: unleash-projects-delete
destructive_patterns.description: unleash projects delete removes a project and all its feature toggles.
destructive_patterns.explanation:
Deleting a project removes ALL feature toggles, strategies, and environments \ within it. This is irreversible. All applications using toggles from this \ project will receive default values.

\ Safer alternatives: \ - Export project configuration first \ - Archive toggles individually for recovery options \ - Migrate critical toggles to another project

destructive_patterns.name: unleash-environments-delete
destructive_patterns.description: unleash environments delete removes an environment.
destructive_patterns.explanation:
Deleting an environment removes all toggle configurations for that \ environment. API keys for this environment stop working. Applications \ will fail to fetch toggle states.

\ Safer alternatives: \ - Export environment configuration \ - Disable toggles in the environment first \ - Rotate API keys before deletion

destructive_patterns.name: unleash-strategies-delete
destructive_patterns.description: unleash strategies delete removes a custom strategy.
destructive_patterns.explanation:
Deleting a custom strategy breaks all toggles using it. Those toggles \ will fail to evaluate properly, potentially returning unexpected values \ or errors.

\ Safer alternatives: \ - Check which toggles use this strategy \ - Migrate toggles to built-in strategies first \ - Create a replacement strategy before deleting

destructive_patterns.name: unleash-api-keys-delete
destructive_patterns.description: unleash api-keys delete removes an API key.
destructive_patterns.explanation:
Deleting an API key immediately revokes access for all SDKs using that \ key. Applications will fail to connect and receive toggle updates, \ falling back to cached or default values.

\ Safer alternatives: \ - Create new API keys before deleting old ones \ - Update SDK configurations first \ - Use key rotation instead of deletion

destructive_patterns.name: unleash-api-delete-features
destructive_patterns.description: DELETE request to Unleash API removes feature toggles.
destructive_patterns.explanation:
API DELETE calls to features permanently remove toggles without archive \ recovery options. All strategies and configurations are lost immediately.

\ Safer alternatives: \ - Use the Unleash CLI for confirmation prompts \ - Archive toggles instead of deleting \ - GET the toggle configuration first

destructive_patterns.name: unleash-api-delete-projects
destructive_patterns.description: DELETE request to Unleash API removes projects.
destructive_patterns.explanation:
API DELETE calls to projects remove ALL toggles, strategies, and \ configurations within the project. This is the most destructive \ operation and cannot be undone.

\ Safer alternatives: \ - Export project configuration completely \ - Use the Unleash UI for visibility \ - Archive toggles individually first

destructive_patterns.name: unleash-api-delete-generic
destructive_patterns.description: DELETE request to Unleash API can remove resources.
destructive_patterns.explanation:
Generic DELETE requests to the Unleash admin API can remove various \ resources including strategies, environments, users, and API keys. \ Review the specific endpoint before executing.

\ Safer alternatives: \ - Verify the exact resource being deleted \ - Use the Unleash CLI or UI for better visibility \ - GET the resource first to confirm
